answer: No identity enters without three anchors signing it — proven identities each at least three hops from the other two and from the applicant, so no cluster vouches for its own. Each anchor pays one quill, $20, per sponsorship, slashed if the identity proves fake; the k-th identity one anchor vouches for costs k quills, and slots return one per epoch. A sponsor whose puppet proves fake goes hollow: history wiped, slots frozen 26 epochs. Forging 1,000 puppets needs three anchors paying 1+2+…+1,000 quills each: 1,501,500 quills, $30,030,000; an honest applicant needs three quills, $60.
